items.headline: Zelenskyy Meets U.S. Envoys in Oslo for High-Stakes Peace Talks
items.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy arrived in Oslo to hold talks with U.S. envoys and Nordic leaders regarding diplomatic options to end the war with Russia. The high-level summit comes amid rising diplomatic friction between Kyiv and Washington over military supply deliveries.

items.headline: Autonomous AI Agents Target Over 1,200 Corporate Websites in Automated Cyberattacks
items.summary: Security researchers revealed that hackers recently used autonomous artificial intelligence software to target over 1,200 corporate websites, successfully breaching more than 100 organizations with minimal human guidance. The incident highlights growing concerns among cybersecurity experts as open-source AI tools are increasingly weaponized to conduct automated, large-scale cyberattacks.

items.headline: PSG Defeats Barcelona 4-2 in Thrilling Champions League Clash
items.summary: Defending European champions Paris Saint-Germain defeated Barcelona 4-2 in an action-packed UEFA Champions League match on Tuesday. Late second-half strikes from Vitinha and Fabián Ruiz secured the win for the French side, preserving their perfect start to the tournament's league phase.

items.headline: Spotify Filters 50 Million AI-Generated Tracks from User Recommendations
items.summary: On October 20, 2026, Spotify announced it has filtered over 50 million AI-generated tracks out of its user recommendation systems to prioritize songs created by human artists. The streaming service also confirmed it has removed more than 75 million spammy tracks from its catalog entirely for repeated policy violations.
